mapper.select:
select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS finprodId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR AS bondAbbrName, itr.FACETOTALAMT / 10000 AS pledgePrin, mbvi.NETPRICE AS netPrice, itr.CONVRATE * 100 AS pledgeRate, fp.REGIST_ORG AS repRegistOrg from INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST itr left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = itr.SECID || '.IB' LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbvi ON mbvi.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and (case when fp.trade_market = '03' or fp.trade_market = '04' then 'CSD' else 'CBC' end) = mbvi.value_source AND mbvi.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviInner WHERE mbviInner.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE > mbvi.VALUE_DATE and (case when fp.trade_market = '03' or fp.trade_market = '04' then 'CSD' else 'CBC' end) = mbviInner.value_source )
AND itr.TRADEID = #{execid}

select distinct CFETS_QUOTE_ID code, CFETS_QUOTE_ID name from IBU_QUOTE_CREP
AND (CFETS_QUOTE_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or CFETS_QUOTE_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))

SELECT qch.QUOTE_ID, qch.VERSION, qch.PORTFOLIO_ID, qch.TERM, (qch.RATE * 100) RATE, qch.SETTLE_SPEED, qch.V_DELIVERY_TYPE, qch.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, qch.FPRICE_AMT, (qch.SHARE_AMT*100) SHARE_AMT, qch.EXE_TYPE, qch.UPDATE_TIME, qch.OU_TRADER_ID, qch.CP_TRADER_ID, cct1.TRADER_NAME mySideTraderName, cct2.TRADER_NAME counterTraderName, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, qcph.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, (qcph.PLEDGE_RATIO * 100) PLEDGE_RATIO, qcph.PLEDGE_AMT PLEDGE_AMT, qch.ZZ_TOTAL_AMT zzTotalAmt, qch.SQ_TOTAL_AMT sqTotalAmt FROM IBU_QUOTE_CREP_HIS qch LEFT JOIN IBU_QUOTE_CREP_PLEDGE_HIS qcph ON qch.QUOTE_ID = qcph.QUOTE_ID and qch.VERSION = qcph.VERSION LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON qcph.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON qch.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER cct1 ON qch.OU_TRADER_ID = cct1.TRADER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER cct2 ON qch.CP_TRADER_ID = cct2.TRADER_ID WHERE qch.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId} and qch.EXE_TYPE in (#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_03},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_07},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_67},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_63},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_25},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_24},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_19},#{EXE_TYPE_IBU_20}) order by qch.VERSION
SELECT TRADER_NAME FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER WHERE TRADER_ID = #{traderId}

SELECT IQER.QUOTE_ID, IQER.FPRICE_AMT, IQER.CB_FPRICE_AMT, IQER.SC_FPRICE_AMT, A.ENTRUST_ID AS entrustId, A.PRICE * 100 AS price, A.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, B.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, (A.ENTRUST_AMT -NVL(T5.FINISH_AMT, 0) ) AS avaNum, C.TERM_DAYS, IQER.DEAL_FEE_AMT, IQER.SETT_FEE_AMT, IQER.CPRICE_AMT, IQER.INT_AMT, IQER.PRICE_MODEL, IQER.SHARE_AMT* 100 SHARE_AMT, IQER.M_TRADE_AMT mtradeAmt, IQER.SHARE_CT_AMT FROM WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE IQER LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST A ON A.ENTRUST_ID = IQER.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD C ON A.ENTRUST_ID = C.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_QUOTE_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T5 ON A.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE E ON A.ENTRUST_ID = E.ENTRUST_ID
IQER.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}

SELECT QUOTE_ID, ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, FPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT, CB_FPRICE_AMT, SC_FPRICE_AMT, DEAL_FEE_AMT, SETT_FEE_AMT, OUR_SHARE_AMT , LENDIN_SHARE_AMT, CPRICE_AMT, INT_AMT, PRICE_MODEL, M_TRADE_AMT mtradeAmt, SHARE_CT_AMT FROM
WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE
IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE
QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}

SELECT T1.QUOTE_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRate, T1.UNIT_CPRICE netPrice, T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10000 pledgePrin, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, (NVL(avaExt.AMOUNT, 0) - NVL(pledgeExt.AMOUNT, 0)) / 100 AS avaPledgePrin, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, T2.FINPROD_NAME bondAbbrName, T2.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg FROM (SELECT QUOTE_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, PLEDGE_RATIO, UNIT_CPRICE, SUM(PLEDGE_NUMBER)*100 PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM IBU_QUOTE_ENT_CREP_PLEDGE where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY QUOTE_ID,PORTFOLIO_ID,PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID,PLEDGE_RATIO,UNIT_CPRICE ) T1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT psp.portfolio_id, psp.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(psp.HODING_TYPE,'04',-psp.AMOUNT,'06',-psp.AMOUNT,'11',-psp.AMOUNT,psp.AMOUNT)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FPSAI ON psp.SEC_ACCT_ID = FPSAI.FINPROD_ID WHERE psp.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND psp.HODING_TYPE IN ( '03','04', '05','06','11','12') AND (FPSAI.FINPROD_ID is null or FPSAI.FINPROD_TYPE2 !='F28') AND psp.CDATE = ( SELECT max(cdate) FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tt WHERE tt.portfolio_id = psp.portfolio_id AND tt.sec_acct_id = psp.sec_acct_id AND tt.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id AND tt.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND tt.branch = psp.branch AND tt.inv_aim = psp.inv_aim AND tt.hoding_type = psp.hoding_type AND tt.ccy = psp.ccy ) GROUP BY psp.portfolio_id,psp.FINPROD_ID ) avaExt ON avaExt.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID and avaExt.portfolio_id = T1.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(-AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FPSAI ON PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.SEC_ACCT_ID = FPSAI.FINPROD_ID WHERE CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND HODING_TYPE = '01' AND (FPSAI.FINPROD_ID is null or FPSAI.FINPROD_TYPE2 !='F28')
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.TRADE_ID = #{quoteId}
GROUP BY PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.PORTFOLIO_ID,PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.FINPROD_ID ) pledgeExt ON pledgeExt.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID and pledgeExt.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID

SELECT T1.QUOTE_ID, T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER/100 pledgeNumber, T1.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRate, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, NVL(T2.FINPROD_ABBR, T2.FINPROD_NAME) bondAbbrName FROM IBU_QUOTE_CREP_PLEDGE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
T1.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}

SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, mbvi.NETPRICE AS netPrice, fp.REGIST_ORG AS repRegistOrg FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbvi ON mbvi.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbvi.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSourceCBC} AND mbvi.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviInner WHERE mbviInner.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbviInner.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSourceCBC} AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE > mbvi.VALUE_DATE )
fp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT iqecp.QUOTE_ID, iqecp.ENTRUST_ID, iqecp.PORTFOLIO_ID, iqecp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId, iqecp.PLEDGE_NUMBER, iqecp.PLEDGE_RATIO, iqecp.fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode FROM IBU_QUOTE_ENT_CREP_PLEDGE iqecp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = iqecp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID
iqecp.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}
